description: This file implements collection utilities including queue and hash map data structures with functions for creation, manipulation, and cleanup.

methods.name: queue_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new queue.

methods.name: queue_push
methods.description: Adds an element to the front of the queue.

methods.name: queue_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last element from the queue.

methods.name: queue_remove
methods.description: Removes and returns the element at a specified index.

methods.name: queue_peek
methods.description: Returns the data at a specified index without removing it.

methods.name: queue_count
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: queue_destroy
methods.description: Frees all resources associated with the queue.

methods.name: hash_map_put
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the hash map.

methods.name: hash_map_get
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a key.

methods.name: hash_map_remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the hash map.

methods.name: hash_map_get_first
methods.description: Returns the first data element in the hash map.

methods.name: hash_map_get_next
methods.description: Returns the next data element in the hash map after a given data.

methods.name: hash_map_count
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the hash map.

methods.name: hash_map_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new hash map.

methods.name: hash_map_cleanup
methods.description: Frees resources used by the hash map without destroying the map itself.

methods.name: hash_map_destroy
methods.description: Frees all resources and destroys the hash map.

methods.name: hash_map_clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the hash map with optional data size.
